557:t_025:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Do you get it? I know.」

557:t_025:9.en:
$$レナード$$
(That my own mother denied my very existence...)

557:t_025:11.en:
$$宗介$$
(I don't know what it means, but the Captain is right. He is shaken.)

557:t_025:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「Do you think those words are just random nonsense?」

557:t_025:14.en:
$$レナード$$
「Knowing all that, how can she... how can she get in my way...」

557:t_025:15.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$テレサ$$ is not right...! She's abnormal! In the end, she's that woman's daughter after all!」

557:t_025:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's... Don't screw with me! Enough is enough!!」

557:t_026:4.en:
$$宗介$$
(Wait for me, I'm coming right away...! Even if a future awaits where I can't make it, I will keep going...!)

557:t_026:5.en:
$$宗介$$
(That very will must have meaning...!)

557:t_026:6.en:
$$宗介$$
(I am no longer a machine that kills people just because it's told to! I'm a human who agonizes, wavers... and then decides...!)

557:t_026:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's too late. The transformation of the world is about to begin.」

557:t_026:8.en:
$$レナード$$
「I can feel it. Even in this very moment, I see countless worlds overlapping.」

557:t_026:9.en:
$$レナード$$
「Every possibility there is... All of it is heading toward the past...」

557:t_026:10.en:
$$レナード$$
「The world has begun to change. You lot can't perceive it.」

557:t_026:11.en:
$$レナード$$
「But don't despair. Everything will get better.」

557:t_026:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「...Do you understand? She will make everything better.」

557:t_026:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「Out of my way, $$レナード$$!」

557:t_027:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's over, $$相良$$! I'll crush your cockpit!」

557:t_029:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「Ugh...! Something's grabbed hold of me!?」

557:t_029:2.en:
$$アル$$
「I won't let you get away.」

557:t_030:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「I borrowed the whole tactic from $$キリコ$$. You can't put up a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ with that machine anymore.」

557:t_031:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't move. You have no strength left to fight.」

557:t_031:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「...To think, at the very last... I'd fall for a trick like that...」

557:t_032:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「I suppose... What $$テレサ$$ said seems to have gotten to me more than I expected.」

557:t_032:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「She... knew about Mom, and still... she can pull a stunt like this...」

557:t_032:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「My unreliable little sister... I always thought she was a fool, but she's far tougher than I am...」

557:t_032:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「...I don't really know. I... had gotten sick of everything.」

557:t_032:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「Since long ago, everything seemed pointless, and everyone seemed like an idiot...」

557:t_032:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「I know I'm abnormal. That's why I wanted to be normal.」

557:t_032:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「I thought this was the only way to become normal.」

557:t_032:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「I want to be normal, too... I've always thought so.」

557:t_032:10.en:
$$レナード$$
「...You could never be normal.」

557:t_032:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「...We finally understood each other a little... And now we just die like this, nurturing our friendship...」

557:t_032:13.en:
$$レナード$$
「Do you think it'll end like that?」

557:t_033:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「The detonator switch for the $$時空震動弾$$. In ten minutes, everything within a 20 km radius of the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$ will be caught in the transposition.」

557:t_033:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「I don't know why, but the transformation of the world has stopped... Then this is just a self-destruct switch.」

557:t_033:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「While I'm at it... I'll make $$ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ$$ self-destruct too, and $$千鳥かなめ$$ along with it...」

557:t_035:1.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「We cannot afford to lose that girl.」

557:t_035:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Major! You haven't given up on the plan yet!?」

557:t_035:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「$n! Take care of $$千鳥$$ for me!」

557:t_035:13.en:
$n
「What are you saying! The $$時空震動弾$$ is about to go off any minute now!」

557:t_035:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「But if I don't take down the Major here, $$千鳥$$ will be targeted again!」

557:t_035:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「I will come back, without fail...」

557:t_035:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「And then, let's go home. Back to that classroom of ours.」
